Dear Karyna,
Please allow me to introduce myself. My name is Romy Yamada and I am an Experience Curator at
TOKI, based at Tokyo.
To briefly explain about my background, I lived in LA from 1899-1994 during my elementary and
junior high school years, and my childhood experiences have led me to join the current business. After

EFTA00571961

 working for over 10 years in marketing at international corporations like MTV and Apple, I came to
understand the benefits that authentic Japanese cultural experiences could have in leading to the
discovery of new avenues in everyday life, marketing, strategy, and creative planning, as well as
understanding business philosophies from a totally new perspective. This realization led me to join
TOKI www.toki.tokyo — and basically, I fell in love with the service. The places which TOKI connects
people with are hidden gems, and sometimes they are inaccessible for the locals to access as well.
It would be much appreciated if you could spare some of your time to discuss what you are looking for
and I will share with you how we can support your extensive trip with an unforgettable experiences. I
am not sure where you are usually based at, if you could pass me few preferable dates and time to do a
call I will try to make myself available. Please let me know your cell number, I can call you from Skype
(you do not have to have a Skype account to receive the call from me).
We have been featured in a few media outlets (most recently the Meridian), so please feel free to take a
look for your reading pleasure.
- New York Times (Aug 2015) article link
- Financial Times (Sept 2016) article link *Just in case you cannot see the link, I am attaching the
article jpeg.

featuring Noma's founding chef.
